scientific_integrity: Originality assessed for the exact period cutoff and its asymptotics, not for the known general possibility of switching-induced epidemic growth. No independent audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic disease-free Floquet spectrum for equal-duration mirror-directed two-node SIS contact matrices only; no stochastic permanent persistence, general nonlinear global attractor, or unequal-duty conclusion. Existing qualitative reverse switching result acknowledged.
title: A unique switching-period invasion cutoff for reciprocal directed SIS contact layers
